name: @ontahi/language
description: Editor-neutral parsing and semantic analysis for Ontahi textual languages
author: Javier Fernandes

scripts.generate: pnpm exec lezer-generator --typeScript src/selection.grammar -o src/generated/selection-parser.ts && pnpm exec oxfmt --write src/generated/selection-parser.ts src/generated/selection-parser.terms.ts
scripts.build: pnpm run generate && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: pnpm run generate && pnpm exec vitest run
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run generate && pnpm exec vitest run --coverage
scripts.test:watch: pnpm run generate && pnpm exec vitest
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run generate && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json
